label: Web deep-dive research plan
description: Propose an Internal multi-step web research plan that picks searxng/search, crawl4ai/fetch, and optional browserless/browse vs lightweight tavily/web-search

description_i18n.en: Propose an Internal multi-step web research plan that picks searxng/search, crawl4ai/fetch, and optional browserless/browse vs lightweight tavily/web-search
description_i18n.zh_CN: 提出内部多步网络调研计划：在轻量 tavily/web-search 与 searxng/search → crawl4ai/fetch（可选 browserless/browse）之间选型
description_i18n.zh_HK: 提出內部多步網絡調研計劃：在輕量 tavily/web-search 與 searxng/search → crawl4ai/fetch（可選 browserless/browse）之間選型

propose_guide: Use when NL asks for thorough / deep / detailed web research, competitive intel, or says Tavily results are too thin. Emit an Internal plan (not live HTTP): (1) choose searxng/search when Owner has SearXNG — else tavily/web-search for quick snippets; (2) select Top-N URLs; (3) crawl4ai/fetch each for markdown; (4) browserless/browse only as fallback for JS/SPA failures; (5) summarize with sources. Set language hints (zh-CN / zh-HK / en) from NL. Do not invent credentials. Do not publish or write-external in this skill.

Emit an Internal plan (not live HTTP): (1) choose searxng/search when Owner has SearXNG — else tavily/web-search for quick snippets; (2) select Top-N URLs; (3) crawl4ai/fetch each for markdown; (4) browserless/browse only as fallback for JS/SPA failures; (5) summarize with sources. Set language hints (zh-CN / zh-HK / en) from NL. Do not invent credentials. Do not publish or write-external in this skill.
propose_guide_i18n.zh_CN: 当用户要详尽/深度/详细网上调研、竞品情报，或抱怨 Tavily 太少时使用。产出内部计划（不直接 HTTP）：(1) Owner 有 SearXNG 则用 searxng/search，否则快查用 tavily/web-search；(2) 选 Top-N URL；(3) 用 crawl4ai/fetch 抽 Markdown；(4) 仅 JS/SPA 失败时用 browserless/browse；(5) 带出处摘要。按用户语言标注 zh-CN/zh-HK/en。不要编造凭证。本 skill 不发帖、不写外联。
propose_guide_i18n.zh_HK: 當用戶要詳盡/深度/詳細網上調研、競品情報，或抱怨 Tavily 太少時使用。產出內部計劃（不直接 HTTP）：(1) Owner 有 SearXNG 則用 searxng/search，否則快查用 tavily/web-search；(2) 選 Top-N URL；(3) 用 crawl4ai/fetch 抽 Markdown；(4) 僅 JS/SPA 失敗時用 browserless/browse；(5) 帶出處摘要。按用戶語言標註 zh-CN/zh-HK/en。不要編造憑證。本 skill 不發帖、不寫外聯。
